items.title: How to interpret clinical trial results for Long COVID
items.summary: With no proven treatments or cures, many people with Long COVID are turning to off-label medications, supplements, and medical devices to treat their symptoms. There are numerous options — and some of them even have clinical trials underway or are reporting results. But even if one study suggests...
items.summary_short: With no proven treatments or cures, many people with Long COVID are turning to off-label medications, supplements, and medical devices to treat their symptoms. There are numerous options — and some of them even have clinical trials underway or are reporting results.

items.title: Abandoned by our governments, people with severe ME and Long COVID are supported by severely ill peers
items.summary:
Mari, a Black Canadian woman with severe myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME), is supported by fellow people with ME in the absence of institutional care.
The post Abandoned by our governments, people with severe ME and Long COVID are supported by severely ill peers first appeared on The Sick Times.
